An unavailable selected proxy reports an error instead of silently switching to a direct connection.

默认开启；即使当前使用 beta 版，也可收到版本号更高的正式版更新。: Enabled by default. Even on a beta build, you can receive stable releases with a higher version.
默认跟随软件的正式版和 beta 关注选择；单独设置只影响插件。始终按版本号选择: Follows the software’s stable and beta channel choices by default. Separate settings affect only plugins. Updates are selected by version and never downgrade.
默认跟随软件的自动检查和间隔。关闭自动检查也会暂停插件自动更新和自动下载；手动检: Follows the software’s automatic checks and interval by default. Turning off automatic checks also pauses automatic plugin updates and downloads. Manual checks and installation remain available.
